pl-l4d6c1-d1e118.summary: Quotes Isidore: baptism is entrusted to priests alone, and not even deacons may perform its ministry without a bishop or priest, unless these are far away and the final necessity of sickness compels; this is also permitted to lay faithful.
claims: Deacons and laity may baptize in necessity.

pl-l4d6c1-d1e124.summary: Adds: a woman, however holy, should not presume to baptize unless necessity compels.
claims: Women may baptize only in necessity.

pl-l4d6c1.summary: Asks who may baptize. Isidore: baptism is entrusted to priests alone; deacons may not perform it without a bishop or priest unless these are far away and extreme sickness compels, which is also permitted to lay faithful. A woman, however holy, should not presume to baptize except in necessity.
claims: Deacons and laity may baptize only in necessity.
Women may baptize only in necessity.
